admission.justification: The same revision changes from proposed to reviewed only after its closeout records the pass.

applicability: Standing of a selected revision in one converted memory tree.
conditions: The selected tree supplies the record and histories.
A positive fact participates only when the retained content has the required review evidence.
statement: The index checks eligible reviews against the record ID, revision and meaning in each named tree, including an earlier filename. A current revision reads reviewed through its writing attempt, or consolidated through a Consolidator write or qualifying keep (stands, no_impact, moved, extended, or non-retiring card-entry deleted row on a listed subject with a passed memory review). Competing content sharing a revision number needs an exact proof for its credit. Unambiguous old standing can survive conversion. Other current revisions read proposed. Retired records have no state.
